name: Asahi
source:
Asahi, the protagonist, is a young man living in the defensive city of Asgard.

He inherited his grandmother's restaurant “Norn's Dine”, named after the goddess of “destiny”, and spends his days as a chef who is well known for his skill and amiable personality.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664240/Norns_Dine/]Steam[/url]]
